payload.test_method: The journal records the preference list order. A current read-only inspection also found the Ghostty desktop entry first; a fresh launch was not performed for this import.
payload.expected_result: Select the installed Ghostty desktop entry before other terminal entries in the user terminal preference order.
payload.actual_result: The Ghostty desktop entry is first in the recorded terminal preference list.
payload.limitations: A saved preference does not prove that every application honors the same terminal-selection mechanism.
payload.provenance: Sanitized import of the system-change journal; no private paths, raw logs or personal identifiers are included.
payload.adverse_effects: No adverse effect was recorded for this preference; this is not proof that none can occur.

activation.details: The journal records this as the chosen configuration, not as a correction to stock Omarchy.

root_cause.rationale: No defect or causal diagnosis is claimed: this is a requested preference.
